html: The Nakako are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Western Desert, on the border of Western Australia and South Australia. The map shows them from 1600 to 1815. They belong to the Western Desert cultural bloc, whose peoples share one language with many dialects and a common body of law and song. Their neighbours included the Pitjantjatjara to the east, the Ngalia to the south and the Ngaatjatjarra and Mandjindja to the west. Their remote country saw few Europeans until well into the 20th century.
